status: Post-results correction of a scoring defect. Made after the frozen results were seen.
defect: The frozen runner clipped only the lower bound at 0. When the upper bound was also negative, the clipped interval was inverted (lower > upper), giving negative widths. Found by an independent audit on 2 Nov 2026: 10 clipped condition rows with negative mean width; the audit counted 1,638 affected clipped condition rows and 2,746 inverted interval evaluations.
correction: Clipped intervals now project BOTH endpoints onto [0, inf): lower = max(lower, 0), upper = max(upper, 0). If both endpoints are negative the interval becomes [0, 0]. metrics() now refuses any inverted interval. Unclipped results are unchanged.
unchanged: Partitions, cached predictions, methods, hypotheses, primary test and decision rules are unchanged. The frozen outputs are kept in frozen_outputs_2026-10-22/.

other_changed_files.code/05_verify.py: adds ordering, nonnegative-bound and negative-width checks; brute force uses the corrected clipping
